CustomField.description: BR-15, BR-16, PD-12. Who declined the handoff, captured from the authenticated Salesforce identity at the moment of rejection - never free text and never inferred. DELIBERATELY NOT OwnerId: ownership is reassignable, while the rejection is who declined responsibility at a point in time. Also NOT LastModifiedById, which any later edit overwrites - the identical reasoning already settled for Sales_Accepted_By__c. Field history does not track a decision actor and is retention-limited, so it cannot substitute either.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Who declined this handoff. Set by automation - do not edit.
CustomField.label: Sales Rejected By
